claim: Try it with sample data in a separate store that resets and is discarded before real use
where: landing primary action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create the real database, enter /demo/, assert six-file sample and separate demo: database, reset, then exit

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; wait for service worker control, set context offline, reload, reset, and assert sample results

claim: Selected archive contents are processed on-device, never uploaded, and never stored in assessments
where: landing figure, upload station, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; inspect a JSON file containing a unique secret, intercept all requests, inspect browser storage, cookies, and password fields

claim: Opens ordinary ZIP, standalone JSON, and CSV exports with a 1.5 GB safety limit
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; inspect ZIP, JSON, and CSV fixtures, then submit a synthetic file one byte above the exact limit

claim: Maps export files into reusable, review, and account-dependent categories with a five-step preservation plan
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context seeded with the six-file Google sample; assert categories, statuses, and checklist length

claim: Recognizes documented Google, Meta, X, Mastodon, Discord, LinkedIn, and Reddit export layouts
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; inspect one purpose-built ZIP fixture for every documented service rule and assert the visible match

claim: Downloads a manifest with the archive SHA-256 and a device-local ECDSA P-256 signature
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; download the sample manifest and independently verify its hash shape, algorithm, and signature with Web Crypto

claim: Labels a signed assessment invalid when its manifest is changed
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; export assessment JSON, change one signed path, import it, and assert Signature invalid

claim: Exports the complete assessment as JSON and one inventory CSV row per mapped file
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; download both formats, parse them, and compare row and entry counts to the six-file sample

claim: Keeps derived assessments and checklist state in IndexedDB across reloads
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; check one preservation item, reload, and assert both the item and completion count persist

claim: Provides nine manual service export destinations
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; assert nine guide records and nine HTTPS destinations

claim: The product is free and the sample flow needs no account, login, or payment
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; complete sample analysis while checking the UI and requests for credential or billing flows

claim: The interface supports keyboard use, 390 px screens, visible skip focus, and no serious or critical axe violations
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context at 390 px; run axe, activate the skip link by keyboard, check overflow, and measure previously failing targets
